UPS MANAGEMENT / END-TO-END SOLUTION

One system. Every stakeholder connected.

From an MQTT signal to a complaint, a service assignment or a purchase workflow — the dashboard and role-specific mobile applications connect the full UPS lifecycle.

MANUFACTURER

See failures as they happen.

Central UPS monitoring and failure alerts give manufacturers a shared view of device health and the issues that need attention.

END-USER APP

Register. Report. Stay informed.

A dedicated customer app for complaint registration and alerts when UPS failures occur.

SERVICE MOBILE APP

Assign the right response.

A separate mobile application for assigning service work and managing service operations around reported complaints and failures.

VENDOR MOBILE APP

Connect the purchase workflow.

A separate purchase vendor application for vendor management and the purchasing workflows that support UPS service operations.
